scope: Source-evidence queries only; does not enable financial model inputs.
rule: Use the second XNYS session open strictly after the later source-local date. Preserve original strings; do not infer UTC from naive acceptance hours.
assumption: The daily lag is conservative relative to typical SEC dissemination but does not guarantee actual first-publication timing or resolve post-acceptance corrections.
identity_event: Require effective session and reconstructed availability both eligible; never backfill pre-event observations.
historical_price_link_and_financial_comp: Separate gates; not certified by this policy.
